title: Concurrent AI isolation: env var detection beats parent chain
desc: When Claude Code and Codex run simultaneously in VS Code, AppBotPipe.Spawn uses DETACHED_PROCESS which breaks the Windows parent chain (parent shows as PID 8). Detect AI identity via env vars first: CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT (Claude Code VSCode ext), CODEX_HOME (Codex), VSCODE_PID (VS Code host). Fall back to parent chain walk only when env vars are absent. Also: two AIs sharing the same CWD must use SessionJsonl (exact file path) for size/content reads — CWD scan picks the wrong JSONL.
steps: When Claude Code and Codex run side-by-side under VS Code, AppBotPipe.Spawn uses DETACHED_PROCESS which severs the Windows parent chain (parent appears as PID 8). Identity detection therefore must read env vars first.

Identity priority: CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT (Claude Code VS Code extension) -> CODEX_HOME (Codex CLI) -> VSCODE_PID (host). Walk the parent process chain only as a last resort when none of these env vars are present.
If two AIs share the same CWD, never use a CWD scan to pick the active session JSONL — pass SessionJsonl (exact file path) explicitly so size/content reads target the right transcript.
